edits.text: PARTIES AND SHARES. This Agreement is between [Seller’s full legal name, entity type, jurisdiction of organization and registration number] as Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. The “Shares” means [number and class of shares] in [issuer’s full legal name, entity type and jurisdiction of organization], as further identified in Schedule 1, with particulars to be verified before signing.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing, on a date mutually agreed in writing by the parties, subject to receipt of the approvals identified in Schedule 2 as required for the transaction. At Closing, payment of the Purchase Price in cleared, immediately available funds and delivery of duly executed instruments transferring the Shares, together with any share certificates and other agreed transfer documentation, shall occur concurrently. Neither party shall be required to complete its Closing deliveries unless the other party concurrently completes its corresponding deliveries. Buyer’s obligation to close shall not be subject to a financing contingency. Any extension of the Closing deadline shall require written agreement of the parties.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as specifically disclosed in Schedule 3, Seller represents that the financial statements expressly identified by reporting period and date in Schedule 3 (the “Identified Financial Statements”) have been prepared in accordance with [agreed accounting framework], consistently applied except as expressly noted therein, and fairly present, in all material respects, the issuer’s financial position and results for the dates and periods covered. Any qualifications relating to interim statements, omitted notes or year-end adjustments must be expressly agreed and identified in Schedule 3.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations and procedures expressly agreed in Schedule 4, Seller shall indemnify Buyer for losses arising from (a) breaches of the representations and covenants expressly designated in Schedule 4 as indemnifiable and (b) undisclosed liabilities within the definition and scope to be agreed in Schedule 4. Schedule 4 shall specify the applicable cap, basket and its operation, survival periods, claim-notice requirements, third-party claim procedures, and any agreed exceptions to those limitations. No recovery shall be available under paragraph (b) for liabilities specifically disclosed in the agreed disclosure schedules, and Buyer shall not recover more than once for the same loss. The scope of indemnifiable breaches and liabilities and all monetary and temporal limitations remain subject to express agreement before signing.
Purchase price remains open pending review of valuation materials and express client approval. No price is agreed by these revisions.
Identify the required approvals and agree the consequences if they are not obtained within thirty days, including any termination rights and long-stop date. Complete Schedule 2 before signing.

Please propose the specific indemnifiable breaches, definition of undisclosed liabilities, cap, basket, survival periods and claim procedures. Discuss any exceptions for fraud, title to Shares, authority and tax matters. No limitation or exception is accepted merely by listing it for discussion.

receiver.message_back: Subject to Seller’s approval, we will provide verified Seller and share particulars and propose a valuation package comprising three years of financial statements, current management accounts, forecasts, and debt, cash and working-capital schedules; please submit your price proposal on that basis, with no price adjustment, escrow or holdback unless expressly agreed. We propose a 10% purchase-price aggregate indemnity cap, a 1% deductible basket and 12-month survival for expressly scheduled breaches and narrowly defined pre-Closing liabilities not disclosed or reflected in the Identified Financial Statements, excluding consequential losses and requiring mitigation and Seller control of third-party defenses; any exceptions must be separately agreed, and either non-defaulting party may terminate if scheduled approvals remain outstanding at the 30-day long-stop, without prejudice to accrued breach claims.
